text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne. I’m a passionate and hard-working full stack developer with 7 years of experience building reliable web applications, and I’d be glad to help with the backend for your legal document drafting AI assistant.

Your project is a strong fit for my background because it combines backend development, API work, and AI integration. I’ve built systems that need to be stable, fast, and easy to connect with an existing front end, and I’m comfortable working in a way that keeps the integration smooth and low-friction for your team.

A few relevant projects from my experience:

- Charity admin modernisation for Oakfield Charities, where I upgraded a Django 1.11 donor system to Django 4.1 and rebuilt the donation entry screens with HTMX. One result was reducing donation entry time by 45% while maintaining zero data loss across 180k donor records.
- Streaming chat widget for Quillstack, where I built the front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streams answers token by token. One result was getting the first token on screen in about 600 ms.

For your legal document assistant, I would focus on building a clean backend that supports the front-end integration, handles AI-powered document drafting reliably, and is structured for easy use by users who need to browse and customize legal documents quickly. I work well with JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, React, and Next.js, and I’m used to building full stack systems with attention to detail and maintainability.

Since you’re looking for someone who can turn this around quickly, I’d approach the work in a practical way: understand the existing front end, define the backend flow, implement the AI integration, and make sure the final system is dependable and straightforward to extend.

If you’d like, I can help you move quickly and keep the implementation focused on the core functionality you need within the timeline.
